8) Bound the residual contributions: express the residual in terms of δ_t u^j_h, f^j, and ψ^j_h; bound these by η^j_ell and η^j_{ell,δ_t} with the decay weights from the Green function. 
9) Combine elliptic reconstruction and residual bounds: bound ||e(T)||_{∞,Ω} ≤ contributions from initial error, summations over j of η^j_ell with appropriate weights, and summations over j of η^j_{ell,δ_t} with appropriate weights. 
10) Present the final computable a posteriori bound: ||u(T) - u^M_h||_{∞,Ω} ≤ C [ ||u_0 - u^0_h||_{∞,Ω} φ_{0,Γ}(T) + ∑_{j=1}^M (η^j_ell · w_j + η^j_{ell,δ_t} · w'_j) ], where the weights w_j, w'_j are derived from φ_{0,Γ} and φ_{1,Γ} evaluated at relevant time-arguments.
